N2.reason: Dropped for FinMem by the project lead, 2026-08-08. FinMem states the ticker in the prompt independently of the news (puppy/prompts.py:16), so a renamed variant yields a prompt naming TSLA in its header and 'Company A' in its body - a self-contradiction rather than a meaning-preserving rewrite, and one the §4.3 audit cannot see because it is introduced downstream of the fixture text. Revisit per-engine: the sibling repos must establish whether TradingAgents and the third engine state the ticker independently of the news.
